reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering monster resources, fish, equipment, pet removal, desert crops and currency, minerals, cooking equipment, and a dish were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover irreversible behavior, drop effects, crop timing, established fish and recipe names, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

BugMeat_Description.source: It's a juicy wad of bug flesh.
BugMeat_Description.translation: Un boț suculent de carne de insectă.

BugSteak_Description.source: The last resort of the hungry cave diver.
BugSteak_Description.translation: Ultima soluție a exploratorului de peșteri flămând.

Bullhead_Description.source: A relative of the catfish that eats a variety of foods off the lake bottom.
Bullhead_Description.translation: O rudă a somnului, care mănâncă tot felul de hrană de pe fundul lacului.

BurglarsRing_Description.source: Monsters have a greater chance of dropping loot.
BurglarsRing_Description.translation: Monștrii au o șansă mai mare să lase pradă.

ButterflyPowder_Description.source: Sprinkle on a pet to remove them from your farm. The process is irreversible.
ButterflyPowder_Description.translation: Presară-l pe un animal de companie pentru a-l îndepărta de la ferma ta. Procesul este ireversibil.

CactusFruit_Description.source: The sweet fruit of the prickly pear cactus.

CactusSeeds_Description.source: Can only be grown indoors. Takes 12 days to mature, and then produces fruit every 3 days.
CactusSeeds_Description.translation: Pot fi cultivate doar în interior. Ajung la maturitate în 12 zile, apoi produc fructe la fiecare 3 zile.

Calcite_Description.source: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.
Calcite_Description.translation: Acest cristal galben este presărat cu noduli sclipitori.

CalicoEgg_Description.source: A unique egg that can be found during the Desert Festival.
CalicoEgg_Description.translation: Un ou unic care poate fi găsit în timpul Festivalului Deșertului.

CalicoEggStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain Calico Eggs.
CalicoEggStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține Ouă Calico.

CampingStove_Description.source: This allows you to cook anywhere, and is not consumed on use.
CampingStove_Description.translation: Îți permite să gătești oriunde și nu se consumă la utilizare.
